method.structure: Unchanged provenance-scoped local curves with partial pooling and training-only pure-tare exact constraints
method.validation: Preserve original v7 outer family assignments and training-selected per-fold settings. Add only new groups to folds deterministically without labels. method.limits: Fixed-settings data-update experiment on adaptive nonrandom evidence; no new independent prospective validation. Tie classification may not imply exact score equality.
